entities.summary: Kathryn George Frost was an American military officer who was the commander of the United States Army and Air Force Exchange Service from August 2002 to April 2005. A major general, at the time of her retirement, she was the highest-ranking woman in the United States Army. She was also the wife of former United States Representative Martin Frost of Texas.
